extensionDescription.message: Darken bright websites, adjust contrast and color temperature, and keep native dark themes when detected.

autoExplanation.message: If the website is using dark mode, its colors are left unchanged. Dark mode detection may not always be accurate.

imagesExplanation.message: This also hides background photos. Regular images, such as product photos, are kept.

disabledGlobal.message: Adjustments are disabled while the global switch is OFF.

disabledSite.message: Adjustments are disabled while this website is OFF.

disabledNative.message: Adjustments are disabled while using the website's dark mode.

disabledInactive.message: Adjustments are disabled while no changes are being applied.

saveFailed.message: Could not save. Please try again.

defaultsExplanation.message: These defaults apply to all websites. Changes made in the popup apply only to that website.

siteScopeExplanation.message: Only the settings changed for this website override the defaults. Other settings follow your defaults.

masterExplanation.message: Turn off to pause the extension on every website, including websites with custom settings.

resetAllExplanation.message: $AMOUNT$ websites have custom settings. Deleting them returns every website to your current defaults.

resetSiteExplanation.message: Delete this website’s custom settings to use your current defaults.

previewExplanation.message: A preview of your brightness, tone and text contrast.

supportIntro.message: Report a problem, suggest a feature, or explore the source code.

feedbackExplanation.message: The form opens on Google Forms. Only the topic is prefilled. Review and submit your report there; nothing is sent automatically.

diagnosticsExplanation.message: Review this information before copying it into the optional field in the form. It includes the extension version, Chromium version, OS and appearance settings. It excludes website addresses, page text, input values and other websites’ settings.

diagnosticsPage.message: Appearance settings for the page you opened Support from. The website address is excluded.

diagnosticsDefaults.message: Default settings. Page-specific information is unavailable; open Support from the website’s extension popup to include its appearance settings.

diagnosticsCopied.message: Copied. Paste it into the diagnostic information field in the form.

diagnosticsManualCopy.message: Automatic copying was unavailable. The text is selected; copy it manually.

diagnosticsFailed.message: Could not prepare diagnostic information. You can still send feedback without it.

sourceExplanation.message: Adaptive Dark is published under the MIT license. Bug fixes, translations and other contributions are welcome.

sponsorExplanation.message: Financial support is optional. Adaptive Dark remains free to use. Payments are handled on GitHub Sponsors.

settingsSupportExplanation.message: Have a problem or an idea? Open the support page to review diagnostic information, or send feedback on Google Forms.
